error_description: The page could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
not_found_description: This page doesn't exist or has moved.
coming_soon_description: This screen is being rebuilt. Follow the progress in {issue}.
page_ideas_description: Suggest features for the trainer and vote on the ideas of others.
page_roadmap_description: What we are working on, per area: trainer, docs, Discord, website and testers.
page_changelog_description: What changed in each build of the trainer.
page_docs_description: How to install and use the Crazy Gothic Trainer.
page_admin_description: Ideas, roadmaps, changelog, docs, users and settings.
portal_private_signed_out: Sign in to see the ideas, roadmaps and docs.
portal_private_no_access: Your account doesn't have access to this portal. Ask the team to invite you.
page_downloads_description: Builds for your game and renderer, with install notes.
page_home_description: Everything about the Crazy projects in one place: ideas, roadmaps, changelogs, docs and downloads. Pick a product to start.
auth_signup_description: Post ideas, vote and follow what happens to them.
auth_forgot_description: We'll email you a link to set a new password.
auth_reset_sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.
auth_two_factor_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth_no_methods: Signing in isn't set up yet. Ask the team.
auth_error_code: That code isn't right. Try again.
auth_error_not_team: This page is for the team. Sign in with a team account.
auth_error_not_linked: This email already has an account with another sign-in method. Sign in with that one first.
auth_reset_description: Choose a new password for your account.
auth_reset_invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one from the sign-in dialog.
auth_reset_done: Your password is changed. You can sign in now.
settings_avatar_description: Shown next to your ideas and comments.
settings_email_note: Changing the email comes later, with email sign-in.
settings_password_description: Signing in again elsewhere is needed after a change.
settings_password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
settings_linked_description: Ways you can sign in to this account.
settings_linked_last: The last sign-in method can't be removed.
settings_linked_none: No other sign-in methods are switched on.
settings_2fa_description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after the password.
settings_2fa_on: On: a code from your authenticator app is asked after the password.
settings_2fa_scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app (or type the key), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
settings_2fa_codes: Keep these backup codes somewhere safe; each signs you in once without the app.
settings_language_description: The language of crazy-hub for you.
settings_theme_description: Light, dark or as your system.
admin_projects_description: Every project of the hub: its sections, boards and dimensions.
admin_roles_description: Role categories, roles and who holds them.
admin_slug_help: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; used in links.
admin_short_help: Up to 3 letters shown in the badge.
project_archive_text: It disappears from the hub; its data stays and it can be restored.
project_sections_help: Sections shown in the sidebar for this project.
project_boards_help: The project's ideas are the posts of these boards. A board belongs to one project.
project_no_boards: No boards yet. Boards are created with the feedback inbox.
project_builds_repo_help: owner/name of the private GitHub repository the downloads page reads.
project_dimensions_help: What the project's content differs by (game, renderer …). They are also tag kinds.
dimension_used_in_docs_help: Shown in the docs variant picker. Off: a tag kind only.
dimension_delete_confirm: Delete this dimension and its values?
roles_suspended_help: Suspended until Discord with 2FA is linked again.
roles_exclusive_help: One role of this category per person (inside a project for project roles).
roles_public_help: A badge next to the name on the hub and on Discord.
roles_requires_discord_help: Only given to, and only active for, accounts with Discord linked and 2FA on.
roles_delete_confirm: Delete this role? Everyone holding it loses it.
roles_claim_text: A workspace admin with Discord linked and 2FA on becomes the Owner, who then gives the other roles.
error_scope_mismatch: This role is per project: pick a project (or none for a whole-hub role).
error_not_allowed: You can't give or take roles.
error_needs_owner: Only the Owner gives or takes Owner and Admin.
error_discord_missing: This person has no Discord account linked.
error_discord_no_mfa: This person's Discord account has no 2FA.
error_discord_unknown: Discord didn't answer; try again in a moment.
error_exclusive_conflict: This person already has another role of an exclusive category.
error_already_has: This person already has this role.
error_category_not_empty: Move or delete its roles first.
perm_hub_owner: Give and take Owner and Admin
perm_downloads_manage: Manage releases on the downloads page
ideas_similar: Similar ideas: maybe yours is already here
ideas_no_board: This project has no board yet.
ideas_empty_text: Be the first to post one.
perm_comments_moderate: Moderate comments, pin the official response, lock comments
ideas_description_placeholder: What should it do, and why? Markdown and images work.
discard_text: What you've written will be lost.
wizard_kind_idea_text: A new feature or an improvement.
wizard_kind_problem_text: Something doesn't work as it should, or crashes.
wizard_any_hint: Leave it if the idea is for all of them.
wizard_category_hint: Where in the trainer it belongs. The team may change it.
wizard_version_hint: Shown in the trainer's menu, e.g. 1.3.0.
error_idea_has_engagement: Others have already voted or commented, so the idea stays. Ask a moderator to remove it.
